idea-plugin.name: IDE MCP Port in Terminal
idea-plugin.description:
Sets IJ_MCP_SERVER_PORT in each local terminal session to the port of the MCP server of this IDE. A Claude Code entry with the URL http://127.0.0.1:${IJ_MCP_SERVER_PORT}/stream then connects to this IDE instance, also when several IDE instances run.

The action Tools | Add IDE MCP Server to Claude Code Local Config writes this entry to the local scope of the project.

action.text: Add IDE MCP Server to Claude Code Local Config
action.description: Adds the 'idea' MCP server with the URL http://127.0.0.1:${IJ_MCP_SERVER_PORT}/stream to the local scope of the project in ~/.claude.json
